rates.segment: Con số cũ tương đương lãi phẳng từ năm 2021, không còn dùng để giới thiệu mức lãi suất

minPercent.note: Page text and embedded calculator data: 'Lãi suất chỉ từ 14.05%/năm' (calculator data last modified 2025-03-19, so over a year old). RE-READ 2026-11-02: this is almost certainly the FLAT / original-balance equivalent of 25%/year reducing, not a reducing-balance rate. Evidence: (1) Mcredit's 2021 launch release for the credit-line product says 'chỉ từ 25%/năm (theo dư nợ giảm dần); 14,05%/năm theo dư nợ ban đầu' (vnba.org.vn, 10/06/2021); (2) the page's own calculator code (loanComponent.min.js) runs the annuity formula at rate=25 for this product; (3) our IRR check: a flat 14.05%/year over 12, 24 or 36 months equals 25.0%, 25.0% and 24.5% nominal reducing. A 2022 VnEconomy article gives the same floor as 2.08%/month reducing (25%/year). Mcredit's newer FAQ floor is higher (2.88%/month reducing = 34.56%/year), so this headline looks stale.

maxPercent.note: Maximum rate not published; page says only 'chỉ từ' (from).

basis.note: Changed from 'reducing' (2026-11-01 reading, inferred from the contract clause) to 'flat' (original balance). The contract clause describes how Mcredit computes interest on a signed contract, but this marketing headline uses the original-balance convention; see note on minPercent.

rates.segment: Khung lãi suất công bố cho toàn bộ sản phẩm vay của Mcredit (trên app), không riêng sản phẩm này

minPercent.note: Google Play and App Store description of the Mcredit app: 'Lãi suất cho vay theo tháng tại Mcredit từ 0-6,25%'. The listing says the monthly rate is converted to a yearly rate with 30-day months and a 365-day year. It is a company-wide framework across cash loans and installment plans, not a per-product range. The 0% end is most likely the zero-interest installment promotions; it is NOT a rate available on cash loans (the cash-loan FAQ says from 2.88%/month). Listing text is undated; Google Play shows the app itself last updated 27 Oct 2026.

maxPercent.note: Same sentence. 6.25%/month = 75%/year nominal. Basis not stated in the sentence; the listing's own worked example is computed flat on the original balance, and a flat 6.25%/month converts to roughly 98-119%/year nominal reducing-balance rate (our IRR, depends on term 6-48 months).

basis.note: Inferred from the listing's worked example (5,000,000 VND, 2.9%/month, 6 months, pays 978,000/month) which equals principal/6 + principal x 2.9%, i.e. flat on the original balance. Mcredit's cash-loan FAQ labels its 2.88%/month floor 'dư nợ giảm dần' (reducing), so the basis is disputed; flat is stored because it is the higher-cost reading.

amortization.note: Terms (06/01/2026) Phan II Dieu 1.3: 'Khoản phải trả hàng kỳ của các kỳ là bằng nhau' (equal instalments); interest each period = R/365 x actual days x remaining principal (Dieu 1.2). First and last instalments may differ. Principal P includes any financed insurance premium. Instalment rounded up to the nearest 1,000 VND.

fees.nameVi: Phí trả nợ trước hạn (tất toán trước hạn)

timing.note: Terms Dieu 2 Muc II: fee is payable when the customer settles early.

mandatory.note: Only incurred if the borrower chooses to settle early; not a condition of getting the loan, but the terms do not label it so. Left unknown.

percent.note: Terms (effective 06/01/2026), Dieu 2 Muc II: early repayment fee = 5% x outstanding in-term principal at the early-repayment processing date, minimum 1,650,000 VND, or another fee set by Mcredit per period. Percent applies to OUTSTANDING principal at payoff, not original principal. Payable at settlement; full early settlement allowed after at least 4 instalments paid (or other period set by Mcredit). PDF text had broken Vietnamese diacritics; numbers read cleanly. Confirmed 2026-11-02 in Mcredit's FAQ (cash loan): partial or full prepayment of principal is allowed any time; for full early settlement 'Phí tất toán trước hạn = 5% dư nợ gốc trong hạn ... tối thiểu 1,650,000 VND hoặc theo quy định của Mcredit trong từng thời kỳ'.

fixedVnd.note: Not a flat fee; see minVnd.

minVnd.note: Minimum fee 1,650,000 VND (Terms Dieu 2 Muc II). Moved from fixedVnd.

timing.note: Charged per repayment transaction made through a collection partner; the terms say it is not part of the monthly loan payment. Whether it is added to the instalment is not stated.

mandatory.note: Depends on the payment channel chosen by the borrower; not stated as required.

fixedVnd.note: Terms Dieu 2.3(i) Muc I: 12,000 VND per repayment transaction (incl. VAT) when paying via a collection-agent service. Paid to the collection partner; the terms say it is NOT a fee charged by Mcredit and not part of the monthly loan payment. E-wallet payments follow the wallet provider's own fees. Whether it can be avoided depends on payment channel, so mandatory is null.

mandatory.note: Terms Dieu 3 Muc I: applies only where the customer voluntarily registers to buy insurance (tu nguyen). The loan principal then includes the amount borrowed to pay the premium, which Mcredit pays to the insurer. Mcredit is the beneficiary of payouts up to the outstanding debt. Whether a particular offer pushes insurance is not published. Re-checked 2026-11-02: the application form has a Có/Không tick box for health insurance and a statement that the customer buys it voluntarily.

textVi.value: Khi trả chậm, lãi quá hạn tính trên nợ gốc quá hạn bằng 150% lãi suất trong hạn (theo năm), tính theo số ngày chậm. Ngoài ra, tiền lãi chậm trả còn bị tính thêm lãi 10%/năm. Nếu vi phạm các điều khoản khác của hợp đồng (không phải nghĩa vụ thanh toán), bị phạt 8% số tiền liên quan đến điều khoản bạn vi phạm.
textVi.note: Terms effective 06/01/2026: Dieu 2.4 Muc I (late interest = overdue principal x 150% x in-term rate / 365 x days; interest on late interest = late interest x 10% / 365 x days) and Dieu 4.5 Muc I (8% breach penalty). Re-read 2026-11-02 in the 06/01/2026 terms: 150% x in-term rate x days/365 on overdue principal; late interest x 10%/365 x days; 8% of the breached amount for non-payment breaches (Dieu 4.5 Muc I). Instalments and premiums are rounded UP to the nearest 1,000 VND (Dieu 2.5 Muc I).

overduePrincipalRateMultiplier.note: 150% of the in-term rate. Dieu 2.4 Muc I.

overdueInterestRatePercentYear.note: Late interest x 10% / 365 x days = 10%/year. Dieu 2.4 Muc I.

latePenalty.textEn: Overdue principal accrues interest at 150% of the in-term annual rate, per day late; late interest itself accrues 10%/year; 8% penalty for breaching non-payment terms.

values.note: See docs/research/regulations.md §6.5 and the lawyer questions.

conflicts.resolution: Recorded as published. Whether an 8% contract penalty is enforceable against consumers is a lawyer question; it is not a late-payment interest rule (Circular 39 art. 13(4)). Never present it as unlawful.

So the 36 months in the calculator is not confirmed as a real per-drawdown term.

conflicts.resolution: Stored flat (higher cost) for the framework ceiling, recorded as inferred. If the FAQ label is right, the example payment is about 6% too high; if the example is right, a '2.88%/month' loan costs about 57%/year nominal, not 34.6%. Needs confirmation from Mcredit or a real contract schedule.

products.notes: The Mcredit app (Google Play id com.mcreditvn.superapp, App Store id1549161793, seller MB Shinsei Finance LLC / Công ty Tài chính TNHH MB Shinsei) originates cash loans, credit-line drawdowns and installment loans. Its listing gives amount 2-100M VND, term 3-48 months, income from 3M VND/month, a company-wide monthly rate framework of 0-6.25%, and one worked example (2.9%/month, flat arithmetic). 'Nhận ngay 15 triệu trong 5 phút' is marketing, not a product limit. No per-product rate range, no fee table, no premium rate. Amortization depends on whether the loan is a lump sum (equal instalments) or a credit-line drawdown (equal principal), so it is left unknown.

researchNotes: DEEP DIVE 2026-11-02. 1) Licence: Mcredit is on data/licensed-institutions.json (id mcredit, 'Công ty Tài chính tín dụng tiêu dùng TNHH MB Shinsei', 32/GP-NHNN); legalName matches. 2) Sources used: live FAQ (mcredit.com.vn/vi/faq; its content comes from the site's own /Consulting?type=... feed, which is how the page loads it), Google Play and App Store listings of the Mcredit app (app updated 27 Oct 2026), terms effective 06/01/2026, loan contract templates dated 06/03/2025 (credit line: econtractcashloan-bpm-old.pdf; application+contract: de-nghi-cap-tin-dung-kiem-hop-dong-cho-vay-bpm-new.pdf), the page calculator JavaScript (loanComponent.min.js), the 2021 credit-line launch release (vnba.org.vn) and a 2022 VnEconomy article. 3) RATES. No per-product range for any product. Published: (a) cash FAQ 'chỉ từ 2.88%/tháng (dư nợ giảm dần)' = 34.56%/yr; (b) product page 'chỉ từ 14.05%/năm' (calculator data 2025-03-19), which is the original-balance equivalent of 25%/yr reducing, NOT a reducing rate (correction to the 2026-11-01 reading); (c) installment 'chỉ từ 0%'; (d) company-wide framework in the app listing 'Lãi suất cho vay theo tháng tại Mcredit từ 0-6,25%' (stored as regulatory_ceiling on all four products because it spans cash and installment; the 0% end is installment promotions). 6.25%/month is 75%/yr nominal; if flat, 98-119%/yr nominal by our IRR. 4) SURPRISE: Mcredit's worked example (5M, 2.9%/month, 6 months, 978,000/month) is flat arithmetic (IRR 57.3%/yr nominal, 75% effective), while the FAQ calls the ~2.88%/month floor 'dư nợ giảm dần'. Both are official; they disagree about the basis of almost the same number. Stored the higher-cost reading and recorded the conflict. 5) CREDIT LINE is real and current: dedicated section (Phan III) in the 06/01/2026 terms, FAQ text on 'khoản vay hạn mức' drawdowns through the app, application form Block 1, and the contract template valid since 06/03/2025 with no end date. Status changed unverified -> active. Facility up to 12 months auto-renewing, drawdowns from 3M VND, equal-principal repayment. 6) AMORTIZATION: lump-sum loans (cash, installment) have equal instalments, interest daily on remaining principal, actual/365, instalment rounded up to 1,000 VND (annuity, stated). Credit-line drawdowns use equal principal. 7) FEES: early full settlement 5% of outstanding principal, min 1,650,000 VND (terms and FAQ agree); partial prepayment free; collection fee 12,000 VND per repayment through a collection agent (paid to the agent); cash/transfer payout cost per drawdown 'nếu có', amount unpublished; FAQ says no other fees beyond the contract. No origination or monthly management fee found in any document. Late: 150% of in-term rate on overdue principal, 10%/yr on late interest, 8% breach penalty. 8) INSURANCE: voluntary, financed into the loan (premium added to principal), health insurance per the application form; premium follows the insurer's request form and is not published anywhere we could read; Mcredit is beneficiary up to outstanding debt. 9) ELIGIBILITY: age 18-65 (FAQ, cash and installment), Vietnamese nationality, income from 3M VND/month (app listing). No employer list. 10) Conflicts: terms 6-36 / 3-48 months (cash); installment max 36 / 48 / 72; app max 72 / 48 / 36; amount min 10M / 2M; early repayment 0 VND (app image text) vs 5%; floors 2.88%/month reducing vs 14.05%/yr flat vs 25%/yr reducing. 11) Not found: any biểu lãi suất / biểu phí for loans (the contract-sample page lists 101 documents; only credit cards have a fee/rate table), an insurance premium table, a per-product APR. Mcredit's robots.txt and sitemap return 403 from the CDN; not retried. A 2022 VnEconomy piece gives 24.99% (partner-company workers) and 28% (others) for a worker pre-approved loan and 2.08%/month reducing; old, secondary, not stored. 12) Credit card product was not researched in this pass (out of MVP scope); its fee/rate PDFs are listed at /vi/tra-cuu-mau-hop-dong (e.g. green-card-26052026.pdf). 13) Mcredit has warned about impersonators collecting advance fees; its FAQ tells customers to report any staff or partner asking for extra fees to 1900 63 67 69.
